theorem_title: Every 2×2 matrix over Q̄ is scalar, has two distinct eigenvalues with an eigenbasis, or has a Jordan basis
formal_statement:
open Complex ComplexConjugate

namespace DiazModulus

theorem qbar_matrix_fin_two_eigen_or_jordan (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ↥Qbar) :
    (∃ c : ↥Qbar, M = c • (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ↥Qbar)) ∨
    (∃ (v w : Fin 2 → ↥Qbar) (c₁ c₂ : ↥Qbar), c₁ ≠ c₂ ∧ LinearIndependent (↥Qbar) ![v, w] ∧
        M.mulVec v = c₁ • v ∧ M.mulVec w = c₂ • w) ∨
    (∃ (v w : Fin 2 → ↥Qbar) (c : ↥Qbar), LinearIndependent (↥Qbar) ![v, w] ∧
        M.mulVec v = c • v ∧ M.mulVec w = c • w + v) := by
  sorry

end DiazModulus
source: Standard linear algebra: the Jordan form of a 2×2 matrix over an algebraically closed field. R20 of the Diaz modulus mission. Formal proof: Diaz modulus mission, 23 October 2026 (C. Perassi).
